Game Overview

Rapunzel Tower puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on embark on a quest of bravery in Rapunzel Tower. Leap from ledge to ledge, dodging treacherous foes and avoiding perilous ivy. Collect magical hairbrushes to unlock upgrades, enhancing your daring climb. Can you outwit the witch and rescue Rapunzel at the top? Adventure awaits in this fairy tale world.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Rapunzel Tower is easy to pick up. Embark on a quest of bravery in Rapunzel Tower! Leap from ledge to ledge, dodging treacherous foes and avoiding perilous ivy.
